request.subject: Change history for export timetables
request.body: Our loss-prevention lead wants a list of everyone who edited our automated export timetables since roughly February. The admin activity screen only scrolls back to mid-July. Did we lose the older history?

rationale: 20-docs-audit-log.md: the audit log records export schedule changes; UI shows 90 days (today 2026-10-16 -> mid-July), CSV download covers 365 days under Admin > Audit log > Download, so February is still available. 20-docs-data-retention.md confirms audit entries are retained 365 days. work_audit_log_csv_download is done and earlier equivalent requests (request_acme_audit_log_retention, request_corvid_audit_log_export) were resolved by answering, so linking completed work or creating work would be unnecessary.
notes: Uses synonyms (activity screen, export timetables) rather than the doc's wording.
